# Copilot instructions (Yoga repo)

## Big picture
- Core engine is the C++20 flexbox layout library in `yoga/`, built as the CMake target `yogacore` (see `yoga/CMakeLists.txt`).
- C++ unit tests live in `tests/` and build an executable `yogatests` using GoogleTest fetched via CMake `FetchContent` (see `tests/CMakeLists.txt`).
- This repo also contains language bindings/packages: Java/Android (`java/`), JS/WASM (`javascript/`), and a Flutter FFI plugin (`flutter/`).

## Build & test (C++ core)
- Preferred wrapper scripts:
  - macOS/Linux: `./unit_tests Debug` (defaults to Debug)
  - Windows: `unit_tests.bat Debug` (defaults to Debug)
  These configure + build in `tests/build` and run `yogatests`.
- VS Code: run the task **Build Unit Tests** (it runs the same CMake flow under `tests/`).
- Debugging: use the repo-provided VS Code launch configs mentioned in `README.md` (e.g. “Debug C++ Unit tests (vsdbg)” on Windows).

## Generated code (don’t hand-edit)
- Enum headers/sources under `yoga/` are generated; they are tagged with `// @generated by enums.py` (e.g. `yoga/YGEnums.h`, `yoga/enums/*.h`).
  - If you need to change enum values/names, edit `enums.py` and regenerate with `python enums.py` from repo root.
- Many layout tests are generated from HTML fixtures:
  - Fixtures live in `gentest/fixtures/` (see “Adding Tests” in `README.md`).
  - Generation is driven by Yarn workspaces: run `yarn install` at repo root, then `yarn gentest`.

## JS package notes (`javascript/`)
- The JS package is ESM and uses top-level await; see `javascript/README.md` and `javascript/package.json` exports (`.` and `./load`).
- Objects created via `Yoga.*.create()` are manual-lifetime and must be freed (`node.free()`, `node.freeRecursive()`, `config.free()`).
- Build/test scripts use `just` via `just-scripts` (see `javascript/just.config.cjs` and `yarn workspace javascript run build/test`).

## Java/Android notes (`java/`)
- Android library builds native code via `externalNativeBuild` (CMake) and packages via Gradle (see `java/build.gradle.kts`).

## Flutter plugin notes (`flutter/`)
- Flutter is an FFI-based plugin (see `flutter/pubspec.yaml`).
- Low-level Yoga bindings are in `flutter/lib/src/yoga_ffi.dart`; higher-level widget/rendering code is in `flutter/lib/html_div.dart`.
- Keep changes scoped: Flutter-specific work should stay inside `flutter/` and avoid altering core C++ unless the FFI boundary requires it.
